'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 1 Bill Kafer DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Bill Kafer]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
